replies: Welcome. You find me in the middle of a composition. What would you like to know?
Good day. Please, come in. Look at the lines before you speak: everything begins there.
Red, blue and yellow, with white and black, are the most elemental colours. They carry no story and no mood of their own. When a colour tells no story, you can feel its pure relation to the others.
I reduced my palette to primary colours plus white, black and grey, because I wanted balance between elements rather than a picture of something. The relationships are the subject.
